tasks.short: Select leather materials and patterns, then trace cutting patterns.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify candidate leather-product patterns and material specifications
inputs: actual pattern library and material specifications
outputs: verified candidate patterns and material requirements

steps.what: Select actual materials and patterns after checking fit, grain, wear and defects
inputs: verified candidate patterns and material requirements
actual leather/material and item needing construction or repair
outputs: chosen actual material and fitting pattern

steps.what: Trace chosen patterns onto actual materials to be cut out
inputs: chosen actual material and fitting pattern

tasks.design: Configure native pattern and material-specification links in {DOCS}. Retain actual leather examination, pattern selection and physical tracing; reduce only repeated candidate-pattern retrieval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the relevant pattern and specification can repeat navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed pattern links can reduce source lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Actual material defects, fit and grain require hands-on judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The worker positions a pattern around a defect in the actual leather.
tasks.altitude: Less pattern lookup before human selection and tracing.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document indexing can reduce pattern retrieval; material selection and physical tracing remain hands-on work.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Actual pattern owner supplies versioned patterns/specifications and worker checks fit and applicability. Existing indexed lookup or physical-only patterns yield zero new digital saving.

No required separate record, report or send is established here. Actual traced outlines are retained physical work. Cutting, stock booking and customer approval are not inferred from tracing; any actual later action must be separately mapped and gated.
unknowns: Is a searchable digital pattern library actually used?
research_questions: How much repeated candidate lookup remains before full material/fit checks?

incremental.description: Maintain verified pattern and material-specification links.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*0.40=6 gross minus0.5 upkeep; low halves gross. All physical examination, selection and tracing retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated pattern retrieval while retaining material craft.
role.ambitious_version: Verified patterns are easy to find while actual leather selection and tracing stay with the worker.

job.title: Shoe and Leather Workers and Repairers
